text: This worked out perfectly. Number 2,000 is the champagne we're toasting with tonight, at the rehearsal dinner for our daughter's wedding tomorrow. Lovely champagne. Lots of bubbles. Straw color. Bready aroma. Dry. Full bodied. Apples. Citrus. Toast. Not at all yeasty. Easily my favorite of this weekend's champagnes.
